description: Geometric compatibility between the AcrIE3 acidic patch and the two basic residues at the P. aeruginosa PAM site, plus the AcrIE3 charge figure
code:
import os, json, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
aa3=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',
         LEU='L',LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V')
def load(path, chain=None):
    res={}
    for ln in open(path):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            if chain and ln[21]!=chain: continue
            n=int(ln[22:26]); res.setdefault(n,{"aa":aa3.get(ln[17:20].strip(),'X'),"atoms":{}})
            res[n]["atoms"][ln[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return res
acr=load(os.path.join(OUT,"8HEL_AcrIE3.pdb"),"A")
pa =load(os.path.join(OUT,"AF_A0A3S4PYN6.pdb"))

# Geometric compatibility test: spacing of the two basic residues at the P. aeruginosa
# PAM site versus the carboxylate spacings available on the AcrIE3 acidic patch.
def tip(res,n):
    a=res[n]["atoms"]; aa=res[n]["aa"]
    for k in {"K":["NZ"],"R":["CZ"],"D":["CG"],"E":["CD"]}[aa]:
        if k in a: return a[k]
    return a["CA"]
dKK=np.linalg.norm(tip(pa,176)-tip(pa,183))
print(f"P. aeruginosa Cas8e K176 NZ to K183 NZ distance: {dKK:.1f} A")
print(f"  (D180 to D182 carboxylate spacing in the same loop: "
      f"{np.linalg.norm(tip(pa,180)-tip(pa,182)):.1f} A)")

patch=[35,53,54,61,64,66,67]
pairs=[]
for i,a in enumerate(patch):
    for b in patch[i+1:]:
        pairs.append((f"{acr[a]['aa']}{a}-{acr[b]['aa']}{b}", float(np.linalg.norm(tip(acr,a)-tip(acr,b)))))
pairs.sort(key=lambda x:abs(x[1]-dKK))
print(f"\nAcrIE3 patch-1 carboxylate pairs, ranked by how closely their spacing matches {dKK:.1f} A:")
for lab,d in pairs[:6]: print(f"   {lab:12s} {d:5.1f} A   (offset {d-dKK:+.1f})")
print(f"   full range of patch-1 pair spacings: {min(d for _,d in pairs):.1f} to {max(d for _,d in pairs):.1f} A")

sur=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"acrie3_surface_8HEL.json")))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
nums=sorted(acr); q=[1 if acr[n]["aa"] in "KR" else -1 if acr[n]["aa"] in "DE" else 0 for n in nums]
col=["#2c6fbb" if v>0 else "#c0392b" if v<0 else "#dcdfe3" for v in q]
ax.bar(nums,q,color=col,width=0.9)
for n in patch: ax.text(n,-1.08,str(n),ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7,rotation=90,color="#7b241c")
ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); ax.set_ylim(-1.6,1.3)
ax.set_xlabel("AcrIE3 residue number (PDB 8HEL, 1.33 A)"); ax.set_ylabel("formal charge at pH 7")
ax.set_title("AcrIE3 is acidic along its whole length: 19 Asp/Glu, 6 Lys/Arg, net -13, pI 3.94\n"
             "labelled below: the 7 residues of the dominant acidic surface patch",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
labs=["exposed\nacidic","exposed\nbasic","patch 1\n(E35,D53,E54,\nE61,E64,D66,E67)"]
vals=[1802,695,723]
ax.bar(range(3),vals,color=["#c0392b","#2c6fbb","#7b241c"],edgecolor="k",lw=0.5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+30,f"{v} A$^2$",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("solvent accessible surface area (A$^2$)")
ax.set_title("Charged surface of AcrIE3, total SASA 4820 A$^2$\n"
             "acidic residues cover 37.4% of the surface, basic 14.4%",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"K176_K183_A":round(float(dKK),1),"patch1_pairs":pairs},
          open(os.path.join(OUT,"acrie3_geometry.json"),"w"))
